verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a passing mention that controls can contain evidence, review history, and assignments. That suggests evidence can be tied to owners, but nothing describes a dedicated workflow for manual artifacts. missing for 10: documented manual-evidence upload workflow, due dates, renewal reminders, expiry tracking, per-artifact owner assignment, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, evidence that can't be automated has a real workflow — owners, due dates, renewal reminders, and expiry tracking on every manual artifact

citations.quote: Controls stay when another framework requires them or when they contain work such as evidence, review history, assignments, or custom content.
